activity_context.topic_title: Area Scale Factors of Linear Transformations

feedback.problem:
What is the area scale factor of the linear transformation $T$ that is given by its standard matrix 

$$
T=[\begin{aligned}7 & 1 \\ 5 & 5\end{aligned}]?
$$
feedback.worked_solution:
The area scale factor of a linear transformation $T$ with standard matrix $T$ is equal to $|det(T)|.$ Therefore,

$$
\begin{aligned}|det(T)| & =|7\cdot 5-1\cdot 5| \\  & =|35-5| \\  & =30.\end{aligned}
$$
